name: Pipe Repairs
description: We diagnose and repair leaking, burst, or damaged pipework to stop water loss and protect your property from further plumbing damage.
alt: A plumber repairing outdoor pipework beside a house
price: Call-out fee R450, repairs from R800

name: Underground Pipework Installation
description: We install new water and drainage pipework in trenches for home extensions and outbuildings, connecting new fixtures to your existing plumbing system.
alt: Two plumbers laying blue water pipes in a trench beside a home extension

name: Drain Clearing
description: Blocked drains can disrupt everyday life. We clear stubborn clogs and restore proper flow with efficient, reliable service.
alt: A plumber in navy work clothes feeding a drain rod into an outside drain inspection cover

name: Bathroom Plumbing
description: We handle taps, toilets, showers, and bathroom pipework, helping keep your bathroom functional, comfortable, and leak-free.
alt: A plumber tightening pipe fittings beneath a kitchen sink

name: Kitchen Plumbing
description: Our team installs and repairs sinks, taps, water lines, and drainage systems to keep your kitchen running smoothly.
alt: A plumber connecting waste pipes under a modern kitchen sink

name: General Maintenance
description: We offer routine plumbing maintenance to catch minor issues early, reduce risk, and extend the life of your fixtures and piping.
alt: A plumber checking household pipe joints and a pressure gauge in a utility room
price: Call-out fee R450, hourly rate R380
